       JOINT APPLICATION OF ONCOR ELECTRIC DELIVERY COMPANY LLC AND LCRA
        TRANSMISSION SERVICE CORPORATION TO AMEND THEIR CERTIFICATES OF
        CONVENIENCE AND NECESSITY FOR THE BELL COUNTY EAST SWITCH TO BIG
    HILL SUBSTATION 765-KV TRANSMISSION LINE PROJECT IN BELL, BURNET, CONCHO,
     CORYELL, LAMPASAS, LLANO, MASON, MCCULLOCH, MENARD, MILAM, MILLS, SAN
              SABA, SCHLEICTER, TOM GREEN AND WILLIAMSON COUNTIES

                                                §§§

                     BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS


           RESPONSE TO ONCOR ELECTRIC DELIVERY COMPANY LLC AND LCRA
          TRANSMISSION SERCVICE CORPORATION OBJECTIONS IN PUCT FILING
          5936 TO EXHIBITS LISTED IN ATTACHMENT A OF SOAH ORDER No. 30


   Craigan R. Johnson, pro se intervenor on behalf of the Johnson Betty Ann Estate
   respectfully urges the Court to deny Applicant’s objection to Exhibits 2 and 3,
   #732.
   1. It is my understanding that during the June 5, 2026 hearing, the Applicants did not
      object to any of the exhibits pre-filed on the Court’s SOAH Order 30, Exhibit A, subject
      to the opportunity to object to late-filed exhibits not previously included in Exhibit A or
      not filed in the Egnyte portal. Exhibits 2-3, #732 were timely filed in all three portals
      and were included in the Court’s Order; therefore, the Applicant’s objection is untimely.
   2. The Applicants filed their objections after the Court ordered time limit of June 7, 2026,
      12 noon; therefore, their objections are untimely.
   3. SOAH Order No. 6, Section 3, Subsection C, Bullet 2 states that each party shall submit
      electronic copies to the SOAH, the other parties, and the reporter a list of all exhibits a
      party intends to offer at the hearing and all exhibits included on the party exhibit list.
      Exhibits 2-3, #732 are intended to be offered at the hearing.
   4. SOAH Order No. 26, Section 1, Paragraph 2, Bullet 3 and 4 repeat that list and copy of
      all exhibits the party intends to offer at the hearing be uploaded to the SOAH, the other
      parties, and the court reporter; while making a distinct reference to exhibits that were
      pre-filed on the Commissioner’s Interchange and any that are further intended to be
      offered.
   5. Exhibits 2-3, #732 are supplements of Intervenor’s original filing and Exhibit 1
      containing photographs. There are no substantive alterations to the testimony, and no
      surprises.

For the above-stated reasons, the Intervenor respectfully urges the Court to deny the

                                              Page 1
 Applicant’s objection to Exhibits 2-3, #732 and allow Intervenor’s exhibits to stand as
previously admitted.



Respectfully Submitted,




   Craigan R. Johnson
   Johnson Betty Ann Estate
